additional_info.subject: Case description
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Is it possible to check logs on the charger 170002647 on the 11th of October between 10:22:53 a.m. and 10:23:31 a.m. (CU TIME) ?
And on the same day on the charger n. 313508370033:
Between 10:33:41 a.m. and 10.35:09 a.m. (Cu Time)
Between 11:09:55 a.m. and 11:10:15 a.m. (Cu Time)
Between 11:14:34 a.m. and 11:14:48 a.m. (Cu Time)
Between 11:16:26 a.m. and 11:16:40 a.m. (Cu Time)
The same customer tried to charge several times thru IPlanet App and Pos, but the recharge was always a 0 recharge interrupted for "disconnected cable".
Can you please check what happened?
As always the site does not give me the possibility to add assets.
Thank you in advance.

additional_info.subject: ID0455814-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002647] Cu logs check CRM:03056000203
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena
For all the other logs, they are all related to the same issue. The customer was trying to charge his car but selected one outlet while using the other one. This means he left the outlet he selected and tried to charge with the one that was not selected. I can prove this with the screenshot I attached below.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
